title: fix(converter): parse CSV records separated by carriage returns

files.patch:
@@ -107,7 +107,7 @@ def _csv_to_json(text: object, delimiter: str, has_header: bool, trim_values: bo
     text = text.lstrip("\ufeff")
     if text.strip() == "":
         return []
-    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text), delimiter=delimiter)
+    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text, newline=""), delimiter=delimiter)
     # A blank line is no row (csv.DictReader skips it too); padding it would add an empty
     # record, and a blank first line would become the header.
     rows = [row for row in reader if row]

@@ -82,6 +82,23 @@ def test_quoted_field_with_embedded_newline(self) -> None:
 
         self.assertEqual(output["result"], [{"name": "Ada", "note": "line1\nline2"}])
 
+    def test_crlf_is_preserved_in_quoted_field(self) -> None:
+        output = converter_node.execute(
+            _ctx({"conversion": "csvToJson"}, 'name,note\r\nAda,"line1\r\nline2"\r\n')
+        )
+
+        self.assertEqual(output["result"], [{"name": "Ada", "note": "line1\r\nline2"}])
+
+    def test_carriage_return_separates_records_and_is_preserved_in_quotes(self) -> None:
+        output = converter_node.execute(
+            _ctx({"conversion": "csvToJson"}, 'name,note\rAda,"line1\rline2"\rGrace,hi\r')
+        )
+
+        self.assertEqual(
+            output["result"],
+            [{"name": "Ada", "note": "line1\rline2"}, {"name": "Grace", "note": "hi"}],
+        )
+
     def test_custom_delimiter(self) -> None:
         output = converter_node.execute(
             _ctx({"conversion": "csvToJson", "delimiter": ";"}, "name;age\nAda;36")
